extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Studio Web with the Explorer panel open on the left and a workflow designer canvas on the right. The project is named "Benefit Claims Processing Template" and contains several workflows/tools; "Process Benefits Application" is emphasized with a red rectangle. The current canvas displays the Main workflow with a Manual Trigger followed by a configured Download Storage File activity using the "Input Documents" storage bucket and file path "In_ExampleApplication".
